description: BTC-first activity-time repricing continuation after completed external liquidity

cost_assumptions.rationale: Every fill is charged 6 bp. Entry reserves one adverse tick; stop execution reserves the shifted 99th percentile of completed ten-second true range over the preceding hour. NautilusTrader separately settles checksum-verified official funding and applies native liquidation.
cost_assumptions.actual_funding_settlement: checksum-verified Binance Vision monthly fundingRate archives
cost_assumptions.stop_market_slippage_reserve: Shifted prior-60-minute ten-second true-range Q99, minimum one tick; independent of direction, path, target and outcome.

validation_protocol.pattern_detector: Already-completed 4-hour/day/week external-liquidity inventory remains independent from the intrinsic response scenario.
validation_protocol.activity_clock: Each event freezes the shifted prior-distribution activity budget at its first bucket and completes when cumulative absolute normalized aggressive activity reaches that budget, with a maximum of nine exact ten-second buckets.
validation_protocol.initial_displacement: The first strictly post-interaction intrinsic event must be outward initiative response and finish outside the interacted boundary.
validation_protocol.direct_persistence: A separate second intrinsic event must be same-direction initiative response, remain outside the boundary and extend beyond the first event close.
validation_protocol.reprice_resumption: Alternatively a separate opposite-flow intrinsic event must touch and hold the boundary, followed by a third outward initiative event which breaks the reprice-event extreme.
validation_protocol.entry: Market OUO bracket after the completed persistence or resumption event.
validation_protocol.sizing: Current full shared USDT NAV times 3 percent divided by expected entry-to-stop loss including both 6 bp fill charges, one adverse entry tick, causal Q99 stop reserve and causal funding reserve; no nominal cap or score multiplier.
validation_protocol.stop: Observed intrinsic reprice-event extreme or held completed boundary, whichever is farther, plus the existing ATR structural buffer and minimum distance.
validation_protocol.target: Nearest active completed external level in the scenario direction; no fitted R fallback.
validation_protocol.global_selection: At any timestamp only the highest causal cost-after net reward-risk signal is eligible; while any order or position exists the account is unavailable.
validation_protocol.promotion: The fixed first BTC week must pass before the remaining two fixed BTC weeks; all three must pass unchanged before multiasset or long evaluation.
validation_protocol.path_ablation: After a clean logic failure, exactly one diagnostic path removal is allowed only when both entry paths traded independently and one is cost-after positive while the other is negative. Diagnostic evidence is never directly promotable.
